primary_qualifying_questions: Which counties and approved trades does your own registered business serve?
Which equipment classes and crew capacity do you control or lease and may use safely?
Do you welcome subcontracted work, referrals, a software diagnostic, or none?
Where do quotes or follow-ups currently stall, if anywhere?
Who contracts with and collects customer payment, and do you prefer separate branding?
Any required contractor license, GL, workers comp or truck permits for offered scope?
